description: Declarative registry of PRODUCERS: the things that mechanically determine a capability
property and write the evidence the calculi read. Adding a producer is a row here — no
new script and no new systemd unit. That is the whole point: as of 2026-08-19 the estate
had three separate bespoke units doing this shape (hapax-quota-telemetry,
hapax-claude-account-live-observe, and nothing at all for agy), and every capability
The failure this closes is not 'we cannot measure'. Every property below was ALREADY
mechanically measurable. What was missing was CADENCE: agy's admission runs a real
reviewer round-trip and mints a 15-minute receipt, and nothing renewed it, so the gemini
review family silently left the floor. A measurement with no producer degrades into an
operator attestation; a producer with no schedule degrades into nothing at all.

producers.notes: 3 = a quota wall was observed, 4 = nothing exercised the subscription and the probe could not observe either. Both are correct fail-closed outcomes and must not read as producer failure.

Runs a REAL scripts/hapax-agy-reviewer smoke and requires schema-conformant fenced-YAML stdout, so the receipt cannot be minted without a completed provider round trip. Measured 2026-08-19: honest, fully mechanical on hapax-appendix, and on no timer — its receipts had been expired since 2026-08-17, which is why the gemini review family was unseatable. Its TTL is 900s, so cadence must stay well under that. NOTE its rc=2 is INDETERMINATE and is deliberately NOT listed as declined: agy collapses smoke-timeout, quota wall, auth failure, and model non-compliance into one exit code, so classifying it as a healthy decline would launder a broken producer as good news. Observed both within one minute on 2026-08-19 — a clean produce in 24s and a self-timeout at 240s, both indistinguishable at the exit code. Until agy discriminates, rc=2 surfaces as a failure. The fix belongs in agy, not in a generous mapping here.

--no-intake is deliberate and owed (seat decision 2026-09-25T01:46Z): deltas are still written to surface-deltas.json, but the intake is not applied until grok-registry's provider declarations merge, which makes most new_capability rows moot; the flip is exit-predicate item (7) of entitlement-census-producer-20260924. The single entitlement view (row entitlement-census-producer-20260924): held x holds-now x declared on every declared host, spend-free allow-listed readbacks only (never a completion, never a Claude probe), deltas through the existing capability-surface intake, quantities in the quota ledger's measurement shape, projection to ~/.cache/hapax/entitlement-census/view.json and the vault. 3 = a declared host was unreachable: its rows read unobserved, which is healthy bad news. 2 = the declaration is invalid or a rendered artifact carried secret material (nothing written): a failure that must page. Runtime: one 240 s network budget covers host reads, secret resolution, readbacks, serving GETs, the scout read and GPU probes. Each step is capped by what is left, and one in-flight step can overshoot by at most about 20 s. The intake adds at most 120 s. Worst case is about 390 s; a normal run takes about 40 s (measured 2026-09-25). An unreadable platform registry exits 2 and writes nothing.
